en: This is a vintage-style postcard showing a serene park scene with a pond in the foreground, a small classical pavilion or bandstand near the center, and tall trees behind it. In the background, a tall church spire rises above the treeline. The colors are slightly faded, suggesting an old photographic technique or hand-coloring. The text at the bottom reads 'BRUGES. - Le Parc' and 'Collections ND Phot.'
